alex: Proposal: soft-unpin SDK 2.9 -> 3.0 on canary at 2026-04-02T02:00PT. Reason: security patch + perf. Any objections? @deploybot can you draft schedule? :rocket:
deploybot: Drafted job: unpin-sdk --from 2.9 --to 3.0 --scope canary --exclude-group embedder --note "soft-unpin canary; embedder sticky-pin 24h". Job id jb-20260402-02-00.
tara: Quick ask: keep embedder pinned. We still see slight embedding drift with SDK 3.0 that affects clustering evals.
ops-triage: Agree hold for embedder. Also request smoke checks for routing and auth headers (recent change).
Alex: OK. New plan: unpin SDK 3.0 for all groups except embedder. Run preflight list: 1) smoke-gen 2) auth header check 3) embedding sample compare (50 queries) 4) rollback dry-run. Rollback thresholds: errors >1% or P95 > baseline +25%.
deploybot: Preflight @T-25m: smoke-gen OK, auth headers OK, embedder compare shows 0.8% drift (below threshold). Dry-run rollback OK.
ops-triage: Note: monitoring will watch model routing errors and auth failures. Pager evict at >0.8% errors.
Alex: Go for T-0 after T-5m ping. I'll update release notes with exempt reason and rollback snippet.
deploybot: Executing unpin. Excluded group: embedder (sticky-pin until manual).
(deploybot): Post-exec: generation endpoints switched to SDK 3.0 on canary for allowed groups. Telemetry: error rate 0.3%, P95 +8%.
tara: Seeing a small tokenization mismatch on a locale test. Filing PR to normalization lib. If it spikes we rollback.
ops-triage: Passing to watch. Will escalate if thresholds breach.
alex: Thanks team. Will lift embedder pin after normalization patch + canary pass. Release note draft: "SDK 3.0: security fixes, perf gains. Embedder group held due to localization tokenization checks."
